title: Learn NSW road rules
summary: Learn about NSW road rules whether you are a new driver, upgrading your licence, or visiting the state.
intro:
Whether you're a new driver, in the process of upgrading your licence, or just driving through while temporarily visiting NSW, being familiar with the rules of the road is essential.

And if you're an experienced driver, refreshing your knowledge and staying up to date is also important, as rules can change from time to time.

More information on driving in NSW can be found at:
